description: This cross-version ValueSet represents content from `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/substance-representation-type|5.0.0` for use in FHIR R4.
purpose:

value set `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/substance-representation-type|5.0.0` as defined in FHIR R5
in FHIR R4.

* `SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation.type` as Example

Across FHIR versions, the value set has been mapped as:
* `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/substance-representation-type|5.0.0`
* `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/substance-representation-type|4.3.0`

Note that all concepts are included in this cross-version definition because no concepts have compatible representations
